gaps: ENGINE: the registry has the Lycoming IO-360-L2A 180 hp with a fixed-pitch prop; the IO-360-C is 210 hp at 2800 RPM - an engine row (as the PT6A-27 row)

PROP: constant speed is a flag the thrust law does not read, and there is NO FEATHERING (a dead engine windmills): the single-engine climbs (front 300 / rear 385 fpm, feathered) cannot be matched honestly without it
FLAP-TRIM INTERCONNECT: missing (the flaps' own pitching moment only)
POD LENGTH on twin booms: the pod ends where pilotLen + paxLen*bays puts it; taperLen / aeroAftLen do not lengthen it (RETRACT-STUDY 1755-1800) - to check against the 3-view
RETRACT: the skymaster fold exists but is marked "to check on a reference"; belly-well doors rough
